title: To Kill a Mockingbird
author: Harper Lee
summary: In 1930s Alabama, a girl nicknamed Scout watches her lawyer father defend a Black man accused of raping a white woman. The story is told from her view as she and her brother learn about prejudice in their town.
readIf: you want a warm, human, morally serious classic with unforgettable characters.
skipIf: you want an unflinching view of racism from a Black perspective; this is told through a white child's eyes.

pairings.reason: Another story of racial injustice in the American South, with a more modern, women-centred take.
A Southern coming-of-age story in the same era, with more warmth and healing.
A contemporary young adult book about a Black teen confronting injustice.
